page.notes: The brace list is set in two columns: left column Hoseam, Ioelem, Amos, Ionam; right column Abdiam, Nahum, Habacuc, Sophoniam. The Hebrew-letter-like initial forms in the list are printed as italic capitals and are transcribed as the names. Lines in the right column read as printed.
